title: Cluster C — Phase-Adversary Gate Wiring (Implementation Plan)
summary: Implementation plan making the phase-adversary gate reviewable: GateDecision carries claim text and refs, plus claims_from_profile and claims_from_context extractors.
notes: Implementation plan (TDD task list), not a formal spec doc. Classified SPEC over DOC because it defines concrete interface contracts (claims_from_profile/claims_from_context -> list[{id,text,refs}]), record schema changes ('claims' map on gate record), and backward-compat constraints. No ADR/PRD signals. No Bash tool available; filename hash segment is a fixed placeholder '00000000', not a real SHA-256 of the source path.
